title: NOC queue-row id label's bare fallback form is never width-checked and can overrun the 68px gutter into the lane letters
evidence:
full := noc_queue_id_label(pr.router, pr.peer, true)
			fw := i32(rl.MeasureTextEx(v.font_mono, strings_clone_cstr_noc(full, v), f32(NOC_SIZE_BODY), 1).x)
			label := full if fw <= NOC_Q_LABEL_MAX else noc_queue_id_label(pr.router, pr.peer, false)
---
noc_queue_id_label :: proc(router, peer: u32, full: bool) -> string {
	return fmt.tprintf("R%d>%d", router, peer) if full else fmt.tprintf("%d>%d", router, peer)
}
---
NOC_Q_LANES_X    :: 74
NOC_Q_LABEL_MAX  :: 68
--- (the in-repo claim) // ...the rare 3-digit-both-ends R form (~86px) falls back to the bare "%d>%d" pair (= 67px still fits) - the label can never run under the lane letters.
detail: Only the R-prefixed form is measured; the bare fallback is assumed to fit. At ~9.6px/char, a bare pair of 8+ combined digits (e.g. router 100, peer 1024 - node ids are monotonic, never recycled, E11) is ~77px, running ~9px under the E lane letter at x=74.
recommended_fix: Measure the bare form too and truncate or clamp the label to NOC_Q_LABEL_MAX before draw_mono_c, keeping the gutter invariant unconditional.
